lead_editorial.title: Chandrakar ka pratyarpan pehla kadam hai — asli pariksha ab adalat aur jaanch ki raftaar ki hai
lead_editorial.summary: Mahadev betting app maamle mein kathit sargana ka Bharat laaya jaana agenciyon ki badi kaamyaabi hai. Lekin bharosa tabhi banega jab muqadma tez, nishpaksh aur poori tarah saboot par tika ho.
body: CBI ke mutabik Mahadev Online Book betting syndicate ke kathit 'kingpin' Sourabh Chandrakar ko Oman se Bharat laaya gaya hai. Royal Oman Police ne Interpol Red Corner Notice ke aadhaar par unhe hirasat mein liya tha, aur CBI aur ED ne pratyarpan ke liye saboot ke saath prastaav bheje the. Somvaar ko Delhi ki Rouse Avenue court ne CBI ko do din ki transit remand di, taaki unhe Chhattisgarh le jaaya ja sake. Videsh mein baithe kisi aaropi ko waapas laana aasaan nahi hota, isliye is kaam ka shrey agenciyon ko milna chahiye.

Lekin yaad rakhna zaroori hai ki ab tak jo kuch saamne hai, woh aarop hain. Jaanch agenciyon ka daava hai ki syndicate cricket, football aur card games par 'panels' aur 'branches' ke zariye avaidh satta chalaata tha, paisa mule bank accounts aur hawala se bahar bheja jaata tha, aur ek hissa sarkaari karmchaariyon ko 'protection money' ke roop mein diya gaya. Yeh sab sach hai ya nahi, iska faisla adalat karegi — media trial ya raajnitik bayaanbaazi nahi.

Hamari raay mein is maamle ki asli kasauti do cheezein hain. Pehli, raftaar: bade aarthik aur online satta maamlon mein aksar chargesheet ke baad muqadma saalon latakta hai, jisse na peediton ko nyay milta hai na aaropi ko apni begunaahi saabit karne ka mauka. Doosri, poori chain: agar 'protection money' ke aarop mein dam hai, to jaanch sirf app chalaane waalon tak nahi, balki un logon tak bhi pahunchni chahiye jinke sanrakshan ke bina itna bada network kathit roop se chal hi nahi sakta tha — chahe woh kisi bhi dal ya pad par hon.

Online satta ka sabse bada nuksaan aam parivaron ko hota hai — chhote shehron ke naujawan jo 'aasaan kamaai' ke laalach mein karz mein doob jaate hain. Isliye ek aaropi ki giraftaari se zyaada zaroori hai ki aise apps ko banne aur phailne se rokne waala tantra — payment monitoring, cyber policing aur jaagrukta — majboot ho. Pratyarpan ek achchi shuruaat hai; nateeja tab maana jaayega jab adalat mein saboot tikein aur system mein sudhaar dikhe.

stories.title: Cyclone Murasu bana 'severe cyclonic storm', aaj raat Ongole ke paas landfall sambhav; Andhra mein evacuation, Chennai aur Vijayawada mein udaanein radd
stories.summary: IMD ke mutabik toofan Nellore aur Narsapur ke beech, Ongole ke kareeb, Somvaar raat 11:30 baje se Mangalvaar subah 4 baje ke beech tat paar kar sakta hai. Hawa 100-110 kmph, jhonke 120 kmph tak.
body: Bay of Bengal mein bana Cyclone Murasu Somvaar subah tak 'severe cyclonic storm' mein badal gaya. ETV Bharat ke live updates ke mutabik IMD ne landfall dakshin Andhra tat par Nellore aur Narsapur ke beech, Ongole ke paas, Somvaar raat 11:30 baje se Mangalvaar subah 4 baje ke beech hone ki sambhavna jataayi hai. Visakhapatnam Cyclone Warning Centre ke pramukh P.L.N. Murthy ke hawaale se The Pioneer ne bataaya ki landfall ke waqt hawa ki raftaar 100-110 kmph aur jhonke 120 kmph tak ho sakte hain, saath hi Bapatla, Krishna aur Prakasam ke hisson mein 1.5-2 metre tak storm surge ka khatra hai. IMD ne Coastal Andhra ke liye bahut bhaari se atyadhik bhaari baarish ka red alert jaari kiya hai.

APSDMA ke MD Prakhar Jain ke mutabik dopahar tak Andhra mein kareeb 2,000 logon ko surakshit jagah pahunchaaya gaya tha aur kul 30,000 logon ko hataane ki yojana hai. Rajya mein NDRF ki chhah aur SDRF ki saat teamein taiyaar hain, jabki Tamil Nadu se NDRF ki teen aur teamein Andhra ravana hui hain. Mukhyamantri Chandrababu Naidu ne apna Delhi daura radd karke har chaar ghante bulletin dene ka nirdesh diya; adhikaariyon ka anumaan hai ki hazaaron bijli ke khambe toot sakte hain, aur lakshya 48 ghante mein bijli bahaal karne ka hai. Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan ne kaha ki Nellore, Prakasam, Bapatla aur Krishna sabse zyaada prabhaavit ho sakte hain.

Toofan ka asar padosi rajyon par bhi hai. Chennai airport par 11 aur Vijayawada mein IndiGo ki 10 udaanein radd ki gayin; Pioneer ke mutabik Andhra mein kul 19 gharelu udaanein radd hui hain. Chennai, Tiruvallur aur Andhra ke kai zilon mein school-college band rahe. Odisha ke Ganjam zile mein 1.51 lakh se zyaada log surakshit sthaanon par bheje gaye hain, aur dakshini Odisha mein 3-4 November ko bhaari baarish ki chetavani hai. Machhuaaron ko samundar mein na jaane ki salaah di gayi hai.

stories.title: Mahadev betting app maamla: kathit sargana Sourabh Chandrakar Oman se Bharat laaye gaye, Delhi court ne CBI ko 2 din ki transit remand di
stories.summary: CBI ke mutabik Royal Oman Police ne Red Corner Notice par Chandrakar ko hirasat mein liya tha; ab unhe Chhattisgarh ke Raipur le jaaya jaayega.
body: CBI ne Ravivaar, 1 November ko bataaya ki Mahadev Online Book betting syndicate ke kathit 'kingpin' Sourabh Chandrakar ko Oman se pratyarpit karke Bharat laaya gaya hai. Business Today ki report ke mutabik Royal Oman Police ne Interpol Red Corner Notice ke aadhaar par unhe dhundh kar hirasat mein liya tha, jiske baad CBI aur ED ne saboot ke saath pratyarpan prastaav saunpe. CBI ki ek team Muscat jaakar unhe waapas laayi. Bar & Bench ke mutabik Somvaar ko Delhi ki Rouse Avenue court ke Principal District and Sessions Judge Nikhil Chopra ne CBI ko do din ki transit remand di, taaki unhe Chhattisgarh le jaaya ja sake.

Bhilai ke rehne waale Chandrakar par CBI ke do maamle hain jinmein chargesheet daakhil ho chuki hai, aur ED ka ek maamla hai jismein prosecution complaint daayar hai. Jaanch agenciyon ka aarop hai ki syndicate franchise jaise 'panels' aur 'branches' ke zariye cricket, football, card games aur doosre events par avaidh satta chalaata tha, aur paisa mule accounts aur hawala ke raaste videsh bheja jaata tha. CBI ka yeh bhi aarop hai ki is paise ka ek hissa sarkaari karmchaariyon ko 'protection money' ke roop mein diya gaya. Yeh sabhi aarop hain jinpar adalat mein faisla hona baaki hai; court mein Chandrakar ki taraf se advocate Tushar Giri pesh hue.

stories.title: Bharat Renewable Energy Summit mein PM Modi: 'Fossil fuel par nirbharta duniya ki arthvyavastha hilaati hai', urja suraksha ka bhavishya swachh urja mein
stories.summary: Bharat Mandapam mein BRESE 2026 ke udghaatan par PM ne kaha ki India mein non-fossil kshamata 50% se zyaada, kareeb 300 GW ho chuki hai; 2030 tak 500 GW ka lakshya.
body: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ne Somvaar ko New Delhi ke Bharat Mandapam mein Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo (BRESE) 2026 ka udghaatan kiya. Asianet Newsable ki report ke mutabik unhone kaha ki fossil fuel par bhaari nirbharta baar-baar vaishvik arthvyavastha ko jhatka deti hai, jabki renewable energy har desh ki pahunch mein hai. Unke shabdon mein, kuch ilaakon mein fossil fuel ka bhandaar seemit hai, 'lekin renewable energy ki kshamata asimit hai'.

PM ne kaha ki India ne Paris ke tahat 50% non-fossil installed capacity ka lakshya 2025 mein, tay samay se paanch saal pehle, haasil kar liya aur ab yeh kshamata kareeb 300 GW hai. Aage ka lakshya 2030 tak 500 GW aur agle 10-11 saalon mein 500 GW aur jodne ka hai. Unhone PM Surya Ghar ke tahat 65 lakh se zyaada gharon par rooftop solar, PM-KUSUM se 30 lakh se zyaada kisaanon ko laabh, aur solar module banane ki kshamata 2 GW se badhkar 200 GW se zyaada hone ka zikr kiya.

Modi ne Africa ke liye prastaavit $200 million ki Africa Solar Facility ko bhi doharaaya. Summit ke saath International Solar Alliance ki 9vi Assembly aur 4th International Green Hydrogen Conference bhi ho rahi hai; National Green Hydrogen Mission ka lakshya 2030 tak 50 lakh tonne utpaadan ka hai.

editorial.title: Murasu ki raat: chaukasi aaj zaroori hai, par asli kaam kal subah se shuru hoga
body: Andhra ne Arnab ke ek hafte baad hi doosre toofan ke liye jis tarah evacuation, NDRF teamon aur school-band jaise kadam uthaaye hain, woh sahi disha hai. Lekin evacuation ke aankde — 30,000 ke lakshya ke muqable dopahar tak 2,000 — dikhaate hain ki aakhri ghanton mein raftaar badhaana zaroori hai, khaaskar Bapatla, Krishna aur Prakasam ke un nichle ilaakon mein jahan surge ka khatra bataaya gaya hai.

Hamari raay mein landfall ke baad ke pehle 48 ghante sabse ahem honge — bijli, mobile network aur peene ka paani. Mukhyamantri ne khud hazaaron khambe girne ka anumaan jataaya hai. Agar bahaali ka vaada samay par poora hua, to yeh tayyari ka asli saboot hoga; warna sabse zyaada mushkil unhi parivaron ko hogi jo pichhle toofan se abhi ubhar bhi nahi paaye.

stories.title: Iran bola — maangein maani gayin to do din mein khul sakta hai Strait of Hormuz; Doha mein teen din ki baatcheet ke baad negotiators lautey, Trump ne kaha midterms se pehle hamla nahi
stories.summary: Iran ke videsh mantralay pravakta Esmaeil Baqaei ne do din ki samay-seema ko Tehran ki 'good faith' ka sanket bataaya; ab tak Washington aur Tehran ke beech koi samjhauta ghoshit nahi hua.
body: Reuters ki report (Arab News mein prakashit) ke mutabik Iran ne Somvaar ko kaha ki woh Strait of Hormuz ko do din ke andar dobara kholne ke prastaav par vichaar kar raha hai, basharte America uski maangein maane. Videsh mantralay pravakta Esmaeil Baqaei ne bataaya ki pehle ek hafte ki samay-seema prastaavit thi, aur ise ghataakar do din karna Iran ke 'good-faith' ravaiye ka sanket hai. Unke mutabik madhyasthon ke zariye sandeshon ka len-den jaari hai. Iranian negotiators Ravivaar ko Qatari madhyasthon ke saath lagaatar teen din ki baatcheet ke baad Doha se lautey; Reuters ko ek adhikaari ne bataaya ki yeh vaapsi baatcheet mein dikkat ki wajah se nahi thi.

Doosri taraf tanaav bhi bana hua hai. CBS News ke mutabik President Trump ne Ravivaar ko phir kaha ki Tehran ko 'the hammer' dena pad sakta hai, haalaanki Reuters ke anusaar unhone yeh bhi kaha ki 3 November ke midterm chunaav se pehle naye hamle nahi honge. CGTN ne Axios ke hawaale se bataaya ki Netanyahu ne Trump se midterms ke turant baad hamle ki baat kahi, jabki Trump baatcheet ko mauka dena chahte hain. IRGC Navy ka daava hai ki Hormuz mein do 'niyam todne waale' tankers naval mines se takraaye. Iran ne chetavani di hai ki naye hamle ka jawaab padosi deshon mein US aur Israeli thikaanon par diya jaayega.

stories.title: US midterms se ek din pehle Trump ki nau tele-rallies; Iowa mein bole kai rajya 'crooked', Michigan Senate race par khaas nazar
stories.summary: ABC News ke mutabik Trump Somvaar ko White House se nau tele-rallies karenge; Ravivaar ko Dubuque mein do ghante ke bhaashan mein unhone chunaav ki nishpakshta par sawaal uthaaye.
body: Mangalvaar, 3 November ko hone waale US midterm chunaav se pehle aakhri din President Donald Trump ka poora zor prachaar par hai. ABC News ke live blog ke mutabik woh Somvaar ko White House se nau tele-rallies mein judenge aur dopahar mein Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool par bhi bolenge. Ravivaar ko Iowa ke Dubuque mein kareeb do ghante ke bhaashan mein Trump ne kai rajyon ko 'crooked' ya 'corrupt' bataaya aur daava kiya ki Democrats ko jeetne ke liye 'cheat' karna padta hai — ABC ke mutabik yeh unke bina saboot waale daavon ka silsila hai.

Michigan ki Senate seat sabse charchit muqablon mein hai, jahan Democratic ummeedvaar Abdul El-Sayed ka saamna Republican Mike Rogers se hai. Trump ne El-Sayed par baar-baar nishaana saadha aur Rep. Haley Stevens ki tareef ki, jinhone Rogers ka samarthan kiya hai. ABC ke mutabik Congress par niyantran kai kareebi House aur Senate muqablon aur governor chunaavon par tika hai. Nateeje Iran neeti par bhi asar daal sakte hain, kyunki Trump ne hamlon ka faisla midterms ke baad tak taala hua hai.

editorial.title: Hormuz par 'do din' ka prastaav ummeed jagaata hai, par shartein aur dhamkiyaan saath-saath chal rahi hain
body: Iran ka Strait of Hormuz ko do din mein kholne ki baat karna aath mahine se chal rahi jung mein ek sakaaraatmak sanket hai — khaaskar India jaise deshon ke liye, jinki tel aur gas aapoorti is raaste par tiki hai. Brent ka $110 ke aaspaas aana dikhata hai ki baazaar is ummeed ko kitni gambheerta se le raha hai.

Lekin hamari raay mein abhi jashn jaldbaazi hogi. Prastaav sharton par tika hai, Washington ki taraf se 'hammer' ki dhamki aur Israel ki taraf se jaldi hamle ka dabaav dono maujood hain, aur Hormuz mein jahaazon par hamle ruk nahi rahe. Midterms ke baad ka hafta tay karega ki diplomacy jeetegi ya jung lautegi. India ko is beech apni urja aapoorti ke vikalp aur Gulf mein rehne waale naagrikon ki suraksha yojana taiyaar rakhni chahiye.

stories.title: Reliance ke record munafe se baazaar mein josh: Sensex 1,233 ank chadhkar 75,693 par, Nifty 23,440 par band; RIL share 11.6% uchhla
stories.summary: Reliance ka Q2 shuddh munafa 33.8% badhkar Rs 29,550 crore raha — company ka ab tak ka sabse zyaada. Brent ke $110 ke paas aane aur FII khareedaari se lagaatar teesre din tezi.
body: Share baazaar mein Somvaar ko lagaatar teesre din tezi rahi. IIFL Securities ke mutabik Sensex 1,233.25 ank (1.66%) chadhkar 75,692.78 par aur Nifty 50 387.70 ank (1.68%) badhkar 23,440.80 par band hua. Sabse bada sahara Reliance Industries ne diya, jiska share 11.60% uchhalkar Rs 1,300 par band hua. Company ne doosri timaahi mein Rs 29,550 crore ka shuddh munafa darj kiya, jo saal-dar-saal 33.8% zyaada aur uski ab tak ki sabse oonchi timaahi kamaai hai. Consolidated revenue 27.8% badhkar Rs 3,62,268 crore raha, aur Oil-to-Chemicals business ka EBITDA 67.9% uchhla.

Metal sheyaron mein bhi khareedaari dikhi — Tata Steel 5.83% aur JSW Steel 5.13% chadhe, jabki Infosys 2.03% girkar sabse zyaada nuksaan mein raha. Energy, infrastructure aur metal sectors aage rahe, IT aur media peeche. Report ke mutabik Iran-Qatar baatcheet ki ummeed mein Brent kareeb 3% girkar $110 ke aaspaas aaya. FIIs ne Shukravaar ko Rs 3,598.54 crore ki khareedaari ki thi. Report mein aagaami Budget mein long-term capital gains tax mein kati ki atkalon ka bhi zikr hai, par iski koi aadhikaarik pushti nahi hai. (Yeh jaankaari hai, nivesh ki salaah nahi.)

stories.title: October mein GST sangrah 22.9% badhkar Rs 2.31 lakh crore; import par IGST mein 42% ka uchhaal, Maharashtra sabse aage
stories.summary: GSTN ke shuruaati aankdon ke mutabik net GST 25.6% badhkar Rs 2.03 lakh crore raha; gharelu revenue 15.8% badha.
body: 1 November ko jaari GSTN ke provisional aankdon (TaxGuru ke mutabik) ke anusaar October 2026 mein gross GST sangrah Rs 2,31,290 crore raha, jo pichhle saal October ke Rs 1,88,125 crore se 22.9% zyaada hai. Refund ghataane ke baad net GST 25.6% badhkar Rs 2,03,356 crore raha. Gharelu lenden se gross revenue 15.8% badhkar Rs 1,59,044 crore raha, jabki imports par IGST 42.2% uchhalkar Rs 72,246 crore pahuncha — yaani kul badhotari ka lagbhag aadha hissa import se aaya.

Rajyon mein Maharashtra Rs 35,150 crore ke saath sabse aage raha, uske baad Karnataka (Rs 15,922 crore) aur Gujarat (Rs 13,516 crore). Bade rajyon mein Assam ki badhotari 47% ke saath sabse tez rahi. April se October 2026 tak gross GST sangrah 13.2% badhkar Rs 14.78 lakh crore ho chuka hai. Release mein is uchhaal ki wajah nahi batayi gayi hai.

editorial.title: GST ka uchhaal achchi khabar hai, par import ka bada hissa sawaal bhi chhodta hai
body: Rs 2.31 lakh crore ka GST sangrah tyohaari maheene mein sarkaar ke khazaane ke liye raahat hai. Lekin aankdon ko dhyaan se dekhein to gharelu revenue 15.8% badha, jabki import par IGST 42% — aur kul badhotari ka kareeb aadha import se aaya. Jab kachche tel jaisi cheezein mehngi hon, to import ki keemat badhne se bhi tax badh jaata hai; yeh zaroori nahi ki yeh sirf zyaada maang ka sanket ho.

Hamari raay mein sarkaar ko is uchhaal ki wajah saaf karni chahiye — kitna hissa maang se aaya aur kitna keemat se. Reliance ke record nateejon aur Sensex ki tezi ke beech yeh yaad rakhna zaroori hai ki mehnga import aam upbhokta aur chhote kaarobaar ke liye bojh bhi hai. Achchi sankhyaon ka jashn tab poora hoga jab gharelu khapat ki raftaar bhi utni hi tez dikhe.

stories.title: Saarbrücken mein dohri khushi: PV Sindhu bani Hylo Open jeetne waali pehli Bharatiya mahila, Lakshya Sen ne defending champion Christie ko haraaya
stories.summary: Sindhu ne final mein Denmark ki Line Kjaersfeldt ko 21-12, 21-14 se aur Lakshya ne Indonesia ke Jonatan Christie ko 21-17, 21-10 se maat di.
body: News On AIR ke mutabik Germany ke Saarbrücken mein Hylo Open 2026 ke finals mein Bharat ke liye dohri jeet aayi. Do baar ki Olympic medalist PV Sindhu ne Denmark ki Line Kjaersfeldt ko seedhe games mein 21-12, 21-14 se haraakar khitaab jeeta. Woh is tournament ka women's singles title jeetne waali pehli Bharatiya mahila ban gayi hain. Lagaatar do hafton mein yeh unka doosra BWF final tha aur July mein Japan Open ke baad pehla khitaab.

Men's singles mein Lakshya Sen ne defending champion Indonesia ke Jonatan Christie ko 21-17, 21-10 se haraaya. Yeh unka doosra Hylo Open khitaab hai — aisa karne waale woh pehle Bharatiya hain — aur 2026 mein unka pehla BWF title bhi.

stories.title: Asian Champions Trophy hockey: Harmanpreet ki hat-trick se India ne Malaysia ko 4-2 se haraaya, lagaatar chauthi jeet ke saath table mein sabse upar
stories.summary: Jalandhar mein khele gaye muqable ke baad India 12 ankon ke saath sheersh par hai; aaj shaam 7 baje South Korea se muqabla.
body: Khel Now ke mutabik Jalandhar ke Olympian Surjit Singh Hockey Stadium mein Ravivaar ko captain Harmanpreet Singh ne 3re, 33ve aur 58ve minute mein gol karke hat-trick lagaayi — do penalty corner se aur ek penalty stroke se. Chautha gol Sukhjeet Singh ne 43ve minute mein kiya. Malaysia ke liye Akhimullah Anuar aur Shello Silverius ne gol daage.

Is jeet ke baad India chaar match mein 12 ank aur +21 goal difference ke saath table mein sabse upar hai. Malaysia (9), Japan (7) aur South Korea (6) bhi semi-final mein pahunch chuke hain. India ka agla muqabla Somvaar shaam 7 baje South Korea se hai.

stories.title: Shah Rukh Khan 61 ke hue: is baar Mannat ki balcony se fans ko nahi mile, 'King' ka pehla gaana 'Tu Mil Jaaye' aadhi raat ko release
stories.summary: Filmibeat ke mutabik Mannat mein nirmaan kaam ki wajah se SRK ki salaana aadhi raat waali jhalak nahi hui; fans ke liye bade screen par haath se likha sandesh dikhaaya gaya.
body: Shah Rukh Khan ne Somvaar ko apna 61va janmdin manaaya, lekin is baar woh har saal ki tarah aadhi raat ko Mannat ke baahar fans ke saamne nahi aaye. Filmibeat ki report ke mutabik bungalow mein reconstruction aur vistaar ka kaam chal raha hai; fans ko ek bade screen par unka haath se likha note aur baahar 'King' ke posters dikhe.

Janmdin ke mauke par Siddharth Anand ki film 'King' ka pehla gaana 'Tu Mil Jaaye' aadhi raat ko release kiya gaya, jismein SRK aur Deepika Padukone phir saath dikhenge. Subah ki reports mein teaser aane ki ummeed jataayi ja rahi thi, lekin Filmibeat ki report mein teaser ka zikr nahi hai. Red Chillies ke post ke mutabik film 24 December 2026 ko theatres mein aayegi.

editorial.title: Sindhu aur Lakshya ki jeet sahi samay par aayi hai — ab nirantarta hi asli lakshya ho
body: PV Sindhu ka mahinon baad khitaab aur Lakshya Sen ka 2026 ka pehla BWF title, dono ek hi din aana Bharatiya badminton ke liye hausla badhaane waali khabar hai. Sindhu lagaatar doosre hafte final mein pahunchi, aur Lakshya ne defending champion ko seedhe games mein haraaya — yeh fitness aur form dono ki vaapsi ka sanket hai.

Hamari raay mein ab chunauti is lay ko bade, Super 750 aur 1000 level ke tournaments mein banaaye rakhne ki hai. Ek-do jeet ke baad lambe sookhe ka silsila Bharatiya khiladiyon ke saath pehle bhi dikha hai. Federation aur support staff ko chot se bachaav aur calendar ke samajhdaar chunaav par dhyaan dena chahiye, taaki yeh jeet ek shuruaat bane, apvaad nahi.
